The Walkthrough

The 4-Hour Walkthrough

A recorded tour of the complete build. From foundation to finishes. Learn what works, what we'd do differently, and why.

Sample Clip

A Look at the Foundation

A short walkthrough of how the foundation came together — a taste of the full course.

What You Get

A 4-hour recorded walkthrough of the Sustainabox property. You get the same knowledge transfer as an in-person visit—at your own pace, whenever you want.

Foundation & Site

Pier foundation design, site preparation, why we chose this approach, and what we'd do differently.

Container Modification

Cutting openings, reinforcing the structure, integrating MEP systems. The engineering behind the decisions.

Electrical Systems

Main panel, circuits, load calculations, grounding. How we designed for efficiency and resilience.

Plumbing & Water

Supply lines, fixtures, septic integration, water management. Real costs and maintenance realities.

Thermal & HVAC

Insulation strategy, ventilation, temperature control. How container design challenges were solved.

Interiors & Finishes

Layout decisions, materials selection, storage design. Making 750 sq ft feel spacious and functional.

Why Video Instead of Cohort?

We realized the real value isn't in a multi-week course structure—it's in seeing the actual systems and decisions. A recorded walkthrough lets you:

  • ✓ Pause and take notes whenever you want
  • ✓ Rewatch specific sections multiple times
  • ✓ Learn at your own pace (4 hours total)
  • ✓ No scheduling conflicts or live call pressure
  • ✓ Combine with the in-person experience if you stay with us
